items.title: KLA (KLAC) Stock Looks About Right Following Its 278% Five Year Run
items.summary: KLA has delivered powerful long term gains for shareholders, and that share price story now puts a sharper spotlight on whether the current valuation is adequately supported by its earnings profile. items.title: Is KLA (KLAC) A Bargain On Its ESOP Filing Or Is It Fully Priced?
items.summary: KLA (KLAC) has put fresh capital flexibility on the table by filing a US$229.8m shelf registration tied to an employee stock ownership plan offering of 1,770,364 common shares. KLA shares changed hands at US$152.32 at the last close, with the stock still up 19.52% on a year to date share price basis despite a 25.97% decline over the past 90 days. items.title: Applied Materials Sinks 6% After Record Quarter as 10 Analysts Cut Targets; Morningstar Calls AI Worries “Overblown”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApplied Materials stock fell 6% today after a record quarter, as its revenue guide missed estimates and at least 10 firms cut their price targets. Management said supply limits held back the guide, and it sees wafer fab equipment spending up more than 30% in 2027.
